confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are bounded estimates from search-result snippets of aggregator listings and undated or mixed-quality price guides (whereandwhen.net, combien-coute.net, Expatistan, Tokyo Cheapo, byfood listings), not verified menus. Restaurant and café figures are the most reliable; cocktail and wine are weakly sourced, so they follow the local beer relationship. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates with no accommodation search. JPY-to-USD conversion uses an assumed rate of about 155 JPY per USD, which was not sourced. The FX value came from RBA statistics-page snippets; cached copies conflicted, so the figure was not opened directly. Summer 2026 peak demand around Mt Fuji may push accommodation above these anchors.
comparable_city_reasoning: Japan-wide restaurant and café price levels, adjusted upward for a Mt Fuji and Lake Kawaguchi tourist-resort premium. Comparable to other Japanese resort towns such as Hakone and Nikko for food and lodging, with cocktail and wine loosely anchored to Tokyo bar data.
